digest.component_or_area: store push and initialization with S3 remotes
propositions: An s3:// or s3+zip:// ticket-store remote without a present and sufficiently recent (>=0.3.2) git-remote-s3 helper causes silent store corruption by allowing duplicate bundles for a single ref

Store operations (init and push) must fail closed early by detecting S3 mode from the remote URL scheme and unconditionally raising OptionalDependencyError if the helper is missing or too old, independent of best-effort push settings
The S3 preflight check reuses existing git remote URL resolution and is inserted at init time and before both push paths (synchronous and async) to catch misconfiguration before corrupting pushes

OptionalDependencyError from the S3 preflight must propagate through write_and_push and be re-raised in push_after_commit's exception handler to prevent best-effort logic from swallowing the misconfiguration signal
Non-S3 remotes and unresolvable remote URLs are unaffected by the preflight and retain existing best-effort behavior
